ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: the Begin-time trust-verifier self-probe and its coupled timeout/worker-budget arithmetic were deleted with the daemon/worker packages. Gate corroborated: no fork/exec self-probe on the Serve hot path (serve.go's only os.Executable use is buildDigest self-identification for the owner record), trust is checked per accepted connection via in-process kernel csops_audittoken reads, and ci/mixedera/peers_test.go carries the documented retry mitigation for the legacy 10s probe bound. A recurrence in the mixed-era legacy gate belongs in its own narrower record, per the residual.
